Markets.title: US stocks: Dow, S&P 500 end higher as traders shift from AI to healthcare
Markets.summary: The Dow and S&P 500 finished higher as investors shifted away from technology stocks due to concerns over AI sector debts. Gains in healthcare companies like Eli Lilly and UnitedHealth helped drive the market's recovery, offsetting losses by Nvidia and Broadcom.

Markets.title: AI stock selloff eases as investors buy on dips amid falling bond yields
Markets.summary: The selloff in AI-linked stocks eased as investors bought the dip following a drop in bond yields. However, investor nervousness persisted due to significant stock declines at CoreWeave and slowing growth at major AI laboratories like Anthropic and OpenAI.

Markets.title: US stocks: Nasdaq reports network disruption, US equities data feeds impacted
Markets.summary: Nasdaq is experiencing a network disruption at its Carteret facility that has created data gaps in US equities markets. The exchange operator is investigating the technical issue and advises clients to switch to backup feeds from Chicago.

Markets.title: S&P 500’s road to 8,000 grows tougher as yields rise, AI doubts mount; all eyes on quarterly earnings
Markets.summary: Analysts doubt the S&P 500 will reach 8,000 due to rising oil prices, bond yields, and midterm election uncertainty. Mixed tech earnings and growing divides between large and small companies are also increasing market risks.

Markets.title: Sebi writes to IRDAI to include investors' insurance policy details in consolidated account statement
Markets.summary: Sebi has asked IRDAI to include investors' insurance policy details in the Consolidated Account Statement to provide a comprehensive financial overview. Additionally, efforts are underway with RBI support to integrate bank deposits into this reporting framework.

Markets.title: IIFL Finance Q2 profit nearly doubles to Rs 805 crore; AUM rises 38%
Markets.summary: IIFL Finance reported that its second-quarter profit nearly doubled to Rs 805 crore, driven by operating leverage and lower loan losses. Assets under management grew 38% to Rs 1.24 lakh crore, largely due to an increase in gold loans.

Geo-Political.title: Bus hits train stopped on French side of Channel Tunnel, with 19 injured
Geo-Political.summary: A bus collided with a train stopped on the French side of the Channel Tunnel, injuring 19 people. Two victims were airlifted to the hospital, though none of the injuries appeared life-threatening.

Geo-Political.title: Trump calls off livestream of Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump canceled the planned livestream of the execution of Fort Hood attacker Nidal Hasan. Hasan is scheduled to face the first military execution in over 60 years.

Geo-Political.title: Russia accuses Ukraine of attacking oil refinery after Zelensky says strikes to resume
Geo-Political.summary: Russia accused Ukraine of attacking an oil refinery following the resumption of energy site strikes. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that a pause on these attacks has ended after fresh Russian assaults.

Geo-Political.title: Maduro pleads not guilty to new torture-related charges in New York
Geo-Political.summary: Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro pleaded not guilty in a New York court to newly added torture-related charges. Maduro rejected the legal documents entirely during the court appearance.

Geo-Political.title: At least 33 pupils and teacher killed after school roof collapses in Pakistan
Geo-Political.summary: A school roof collapsed in Pakistan, killing at least 33 pupils and a teacher. The disaster buried children under the debris as it crashed through three classrooms.

Geo-Political.title: Houthi missile attack on Yemeni presidential palace kills two, minister says
Geo-Political.summary: Ballistic missiles launched by Houthi forces struck the al-Maashiq presidential palace in Yemen, resulting in two deaths. Yemen's information minister confirmed that the prime minister and other government ministers escaped the attack unhurt.

Data & Insights.title: India may hike fuel prices in November, pushing inflation above RBI target: Oxford Economist
Data & Insights.summary: Oxford Economics predicts India might moderately increase fuel prices in November ahead of early next year's state elections. This potential price hike is expected to push inflation above the Reserve Bank of India's target.

Data & Insights.title: Put private sector at center of development agenda: Sitharaman to World Bank
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Finance Minister Sitharaman urged the World Bank to place the private sector at the center of its development agenda to prioritize job creation and productivity. She also called on the multilateral lender to provide competitive pricing and local currency financing tools.

Data & Insights.title: RBI’s new forex reserve rules explained: FAQs on the 20% requirement, $2 million threshold and exemptions
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has clarified its 20% foreign exchange risk reserve requirement for rupee-linked currency derivatives. The new guidance details specific application rules, including a $2 million threshold, exemptions, cancellations, and rollovers.

Data & Insights.title: US wholesale inflation hits four-year high of 6.3% in September as gas prices surge
Data & Insights.summary: US wholesale inflation accelerated to 6.3% in September, marking the highest level since December 2022. A sharp rise in gasoline prices was the primary driver behind the increase in producer costs.

Data & Insights.title: Unemployment rate rises in urban areas in September
Data & Insights.summary: Urban unemployment increased in September, driving a rise in city joblessness. However, stable employment rates in rural areas kept the overall national joblessness rate steady.

Data & Insights.title: Net direct tax collections up 13.2% at  ₹13.38 tn, corporate tax buoys
Data & Insights.summary: India's net direct tax collections rose 13.2% to ₹13.38 trillion. This growth was primarily driven by strong corporate tax receipts amid improving economic conditions.

India.title: Two Chain Snatchers Injured In Police Firing In Guwahati
India.summary: Two chain snatchers in Guwahati were injured in police firing and subsequently remanded to two days in police custody. During interrogation, the suspects provided information about their gang's methods and agreed to help investigators catch other members.

India.title: Kolkata Film Institute Vice Chancellor Allegedly Manhandled Amid Protest
India.summary: The Vice Chancellor of the Kolkata Film Institute was allegedly manhandled during a protest on Wednesday night. Protesters also vandalized his office, causing extensive damage to windows, furniture, and utility lines.

India.title: "Rahul Gandhi Thinks Mobocracy Is The Way": Smriti Irani To NDTV
India.summary: Union Minister Smriti Irani accused Rahul Gandhi of promoting mobocracy through his constant attacks on the Election Commission of India. She stated that the Election Commission is responsible for ensuring a vibrant democracy in the country.

India.title: "His Own Empire": VD Satheesan On Pinarayi Vijayan's Infra Board Irregularities
India.summary: Kerala opposition leader VD Satheesan criticized Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan over irregularities within the Kerala Infrastructure Investment Fund Board (KIIFB). A report revealed that the board unlawfully expanded its staff, spent ₹203.72 crore on publicity in one year, and self-approved its borrowing guarantees.

India.title: VFS Global To Open First Visa Application Centre In Guwahati
India.summary: VFS Global is opening its first visa application centre in Guwahati to serve residents of eight Northeastern states. The new facility provides improved regional access to visa services through strong air, rail, and road connections.

India.title: B****y S**t: IAS Officer Abuses Woman Colleague In Virtual Meeting In J&K
India.summary: Kumar Rajeev Ranjan, a Jammu and Kashmir IAS officer, used abusive language against a woman colleague during a virtual official meeting. He serves as the Secretary of the Labour and Employment Department.

General.title: Trump calls off livestream of Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad
General.summary: Former President Trump cancelled the planned livestream of the execution of Nidal Hasan, the Fort Hood attacker. This would have been the first military execution in over 60 years.

General.title: Trans people should use hospital spaces according to biological sex, NHS England says
General.summary: NHS England has issued new guidance stating that transgender patients should be cared for in hospital wards or bays that align with their biological sex. This policy applies to single-sex hospital spaces across the healthcare system.
